baseline_prompt_en: A Gaslamp Fantasy photographic scene, where late-Victorian social life and visible practical enchantment coexist. The woman whose facial appearance and dark bob follow the supplied reference takes part in a moment of ordinary human business altered by visible magic. Use the supplied reference for her softly rounded face, large dark eyes, small natural lips, chin-length straight black bob and fine wispy bangs. In a railway patron's private drawing room just after dusk, she sits at the left side of a small polished mahogany table, asking for passage by presenting a cream travel permit. A silver-haired patron in a charcoal frock coat sits opposite, looking down at the permit with a restrained, newly attentive expression. She wears a fitted muted jade wool traveling jacket over an ivory high-collared blouse; the quiet elegance of her upright bearing and slightly parted lips gives her a subtle, human magnetism. Her right hand supports the near lower edge of the permit and her left rests naturally on the table; the patron's extended right hand hovers a hand's width above its red wax seal. One fine continuous pale-gold luminous thread rises from the wax seal and curves to the signet ring on the patron's right index finger, visibly touching both endpoints. The little suspended arc casts a faint gold reflection on the cream paper as he pauses before accepting it. Both wrists, hands, the complete permit, the seal, ring and full connecting thread are visible together. A twin gas wall sconce with visible small flames illuminates figured wallpaper and dark walnut molding; the window behind them holds a dim blue evening. A three-quarter eye-level medium two-shot, framed from their heads to below the tabletop, keeps her face, their separated hands and the suspended thread readable in the same focus plane. The viewer first notices her attentive face, then follows her offered paper toward his arrested hand. Warm gaslight, cool dusk, restrained color and tactile photographic grain create an intimate, plausible period photograph of a consequential negotiation.
